```
    41→
    42→def _apply_plan_reconciliation(plan: dict[str, object], state: state_mod.StateModel, reconcile_fn) -> bool:
    43→    """Apply standard post-scan plan reconciliation when user content exists."""
    44→    if not _plan_has_user_content(plan):
    45→        return False
    46→    recon = reconcile_fn(plan, state)
    47→    if recon.resurfaced:
    48→        print(
    49→            colorize(
    50→                f"  Plan: {len(recon.resurfaced)} skipped item(s) re-surfaced after review period.",
    51→                "cyan",
    52→            )
    53→        )
    54→    return bool(recon.changes)
    55→
    56→
    57→def _sync_unscored_dimensions(plan: dict[str, object], state: state_mod.StateModel, sync_fn) -> bool:
    58→    """Sync unscored subjective dimensions into the plan queue."""
    59→    sync = sync_fn(plan, state)

    61→        print(
    62→            colorize(

    64→                "cyan",

    66→        )

    68→
    69→
    70→def _sync_stale_dimensions(plan: dict[str, object], state: state_mod.StateModel, sync_fn) -> bool:
    71→    """Sync stale subjective dimensions (prune refreshed + inject stale) in plan queue."""
    72→    sync = sync_fn(plan, state)
    73→    if sync.pruned:
    74→        print(
    75→            colorize(
    76→                f"  Plan: {len(sync.pruned)} refreshed subjective dimension(s) removed from queue.",
    77→                "cyan",
    78→            )
    79→        )
    80→    if sync.injected:
    81→        print(
    82→            colorize(
    83→                f"  Plan: {len(sync.injected)} subjective dimension(s) queued for review.",
    84→                "cyan",
    85→            )
    86→        )

    88→
    89→
    90→def _sync_auto_clusters(
    91→    plan: dict[str, object],
    92→    state: state_mod.StateModel,
    93→    *,
    94→    target_strict: float = DEFAULT_TARGET_STRICT_SCORE,
    95→    policy=None,
    96→    cycle_just_completed: bool = False,
    97→) -> bool:
    98→    """Regenerate automatic task clusters after scan merge."""
    99→    return bool(auto_cluster_issues(
   100→        plan, state,
   101→        target_strict=target_strict,
   102→        policy=policy,
   103→        cycle_just_completed=cycle_just_completed,
   104→    ))
   105→
   106→
   107→def _seed_plan_start_scores(plan: dict[str, object], state: state_mod.StateModel) -> bool:
   108→    """Set plan_start_scores when beginning a new queue cycle."""
   109→    existing = plan.get("plan_start_scores")
   110→    if existing and not isinstance(existing, dict):
   111→        return False
   112→    # Seed when empty OR when it's the reset sentinel ({"reset": True})
   113→    if existing and not existing.get("reset"):
   114→        return False
   115→    scores = state_mod.score_snapshot(state)
   116→    if scores.strict is None:
   117→        return False
   118→    plan["plan_start_scores"] = {
   119→        "strict": scores.strict,
   120→        "overall": scores.overall,
   121→        "objective": scores.objective,
   122→        "verified": scores.verified,
   123→    }
   124→    # Record scan count at cycle start so gates can detect whether a new scan ran
   125→    plan["scan_count_at_plan_start"] = int(state.get("scan_count", 0) or 0)
   126→    return True
   127→
   128→
   129→def _clear_plan_start_scores_if_queue_empty(
   130→    state: state_mod.StateModel, plan: dict[str, object]
   131→) -> bool:
   132→    """Clear plan-start score snapshot once the queue is fully drained."""
   133→    if not plan.get("plan_start_scores"):
   134→        return False
   135→
   136→    try:
   137→        from desloppify.app.commands.helpers.queue_progress import (
   138→            ScoreDisplayMode,
   139→            plan_aware_queue_breakdown,
   140→            score_display_mode,
   141→        )
   142→
   143→        breakdown = plan_aware_queue_breakdown(state, plan)
   144→        frozen_strict = plan.get("plan_start_scores", {}).get("strict")
   145→        queue_empty = score_display_mode(breakdown, frozen_strict) is not ScoreDisplayMode.FROZEN
   146→    except PLAN_LOAD_EXCEPTIONS as exc:
   147→        log_best_effort_failure(logger, "run post-scan plan reconciliation", exc)
   148→        return False
   149→    if not queue_empty:
   150→        return False
   151→    state["_plan_start_scores_for_reveal"] = dict(plan["plan_start_scores"])
   152→    plan["plan_start_scores"] = {}
   153→    return True
   154→
   155→
   156→def _subjective_policy_context(
   157→    runtime: ScanRuntime,
   158→    plan: dict[str, object],
   159→) -> tuple[float, object, bool]:
   160→    from desloppify.base.config import target_strict_score_from_config
   161→    from desloppify.engine.plan import compute_subjective_visibility
   162→
   163→    target_strict = target_strict_score_from_config(runtime.config)
   164→    policy = compute_subjective_visibility(
   165→        runtime.state,
   166→        target_strict=target_strict,
   167→        plan=plan,
   168→    )
   169→    cycle_just_completed = not plan.get("plan_start_scores")
   170→    return target_strict, policy, cycle_just_completed
   171→
   172→
   173→def _sync_unscored_and_log(
   174→    plan: dict[str, object],
   175→    state: state_mod.StateModel,
   176→) -> bool:
   177→    changed = _sync_unscored_dimensions(plan, state, sync_unscored_dimensions)
   178→    if changed:
   179→        append_log_entry(plan, "sync_unscored", actor="system", detail={"changes": True})
   180→    return changed
   181→
   182→
   183→def _sync_stale_and_log(
   184→    plan: dict[str, object],
   185→    state: state_mod.StateModel,
   186→    *,
   187→    policy,
   188→    cycle_just_completed: bool,
   189→) -> bool:
   190→    changed = _sync_stale_dimensions(
   191→        plan,
   192→        state,
   193→        lambda p, s: sync_stale_dimensions(
   194→            p,
   195→            s,
   196→            policy=policy,
   197→            cycle_just_completed=cycle_just_completed,
   198→        ),
   199→    )
   200→    if changed:
   201→        append_log_entry(plan, "sync_stale", actor="system", detail={"changes": True})
   202→    return changed
   203→
   204→
   205→def _sync_auto_clusters_and_log(
   206→    plan: dict[str, object],
   207→    state: state_mod.StateModel,
   208→    *,
   209→    target_strict: float,
   210→    policy,
   211→    cycle_just_completed: bool,
   212→) -> bool:
   213→    changed = _sync_auto_clusters(
   214→        plan,
   215→        state,
   216→        target_strict=target_strict,
   217→        policy=policy,
   218→        cycle_just_completed=cycle_just_completed,
   219→    )
   220→    if changed:
   221→        append_log_entry(plan, "auto_cluster", actor="system", detail={"changes": True})
   222→    return changed
   223→
   224→
   225→def _sync_triage_and_log(
   226→    plan: dict[str, object],
   227→    state: state_mod.StateModel,
   228→    *,
   229→    policy=None,
   230→) -> bool:
   231→    triage_sync = sync_triage_needed(plan, state, policy=policy)
   232→    if triage_sync.deferred:
   233→        meta = plan.get("epic_triage_meta", {})
   234→        if meta.get("triage_recommended"):
   235→            print(
   236→                colorize(
   237→                    "  Plan: review issues changed — triage recommended after current work.",
   238→                    "dim",
   239→                )
   240→            )
   241→        return False
   242→    if not triage_sync.changes:
   243→        return False
   244→    if triage_sync.injected:
   245→        print(
   246→            colorize(
   247→                "  Plan: planning mode needed — review issues changed since last triage.",
   248→                "cyan",
   249→            )
   250→        )
   251→        append_log_entry(plan, "sync_triage", actor="system", detail={"injected": True})
   252→    return True
   253→
   254→
   255→def _sync_communicate_score_and_log(
   256→    plan: dict[str, object],
   257→    state: state_mod.StateModel,
   258→    *,
   259→    policy,
   260→) -> bool:
   261→    communicate_sync = sync_communicate_score_needed(plan, state, policy=policy)
   262→    if not communicate_sync.changes:
   263→        return False
   264→    append_log_entry(
   265→        plan,
   266→        "sync_communicate_score",
   267→        actor="system",
   268→        detail={"injected": True},
   269→    )
   270→    return True
   271→
   272→
   273→def _sync_create_plan_and_log(
   274→    plan: dict[str, object],
   275→    state: state_mod.StateModel,
   276→    *,
   277→    policy,
   278→) -> bool:
   279→    create_plan_sync = sync_create_plan_needed(plan, state, policy=policy)
   280→    if not create_plan_sync.changes:
   281→        return False
   282→    if create_plan_sync.injected:
   283→        print(
   284→            colorize(
   285→                "  Plan: reviews complete — `workflow::create-plan` queued.",
   286→                "cyan",
   287→            )
   288→        )
   289→        append_log_entry(plan, "sync_create_plan", actor="system", detail={"injected": True})
   290→    return True
   291→
   292→
   293→def _sync_plan_start_scores_and_log(
   294→    plan: dict[str, object],
   295→    state: state_mod.StateModel,
   296→) -> bool:
   297→    seeded = _seed_plan_start_scores(plan, state)
   298→    if seeded:
   299→        append_log_entry(plan, "seed_start_scores", actor="system", detail={})
   300→        return True
   301→    # Only clear scores that existed before this reconcile pass —
   302→    # never clear scores we just seeded in the same scan.
   303→    cleared = _clear_plan_start_scores_if_queue_empty(state, plan)
   304→    if cleared:
   305→        append_log_entry(plan, "clear_start_scores", actor="system", detail={})
   306→    return cleared
   307→
   308→
   309→def reconcile_plan_post_scan(runtime: ScanRuntime) -> None:
   310→    """Reconcile plan queue metadata and stale subjective review dimensions."""
   311→    plan_path = runtime.state_path.parent / "plan.json" if runtime.state_path else None
   312→    try:
   313→        plan = load_plan(plan_path)
   314→    except PLAN_LOAD_EXCEPTIONS as exc:
   315→        logger.warning("Plan reconciliation skipped (load failed): %s", exc)
   316→        return
   317→    dirty = False
   318→
   319→    if _apply_plan_reconciliation(plan, runtime.state, reconcile_plan_after_scan):
   320→        dirty = True
   321→
   322→    if _sync_unscored_and_log(plan, runtime.state):
   323→        dirty = True
   324→
   325→    target_strict, policy, cycle_just_completed = _subjective_policy_context(
   326→        runtime,
   327→        plan,
   328→    )
   329→    if _sync_stale_and_log(
   330→        plan,
   331→        runtime.state,
   332→        policy=policy,
   333→        cycle_just_completed=cycle_just_completed,
   334→    ):
   335→        dirty = True
   336→
   337→    if _sync_auto_clusters_and_log(
   338→        plan,
   339→        runtime.state,
   340→        target_strict=target_strict,
   341→        policy=policy,
   342→        cycle_just_completed=cycle_just_completed,
   343→    ):
   344→        dirty = True
   345→
   346→    if _sync_communicate_score_and_log(plan, runtime.state, policy=policy):
   347→        dirty = True
   348→    if _sync_create_plan_and_log(plan, runtime.state, policy=policy):
   349→        dirty = True
   350→    if _sync_triage_and_log(plan, runtime.state, policy=policy):
   351→        dirty = True
   352→    if _sync_plan_start_scores_and_log(plan, runtime.state):
   353→        dirty = True
   354→
   355→    if dirty:
   356→        try:
   357→            save_plan(plan, plan_path)
   358→        except PLAN_LOAD_EXCEPTIONS as exc:
   359→            logger.warning("Plan reconciliation save failed: %s", exc)
   360→
```

```
    30→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    31→# QueueBreakdown — single source of truth for queue numbers
    32→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    33→
    34→@dataclass(frozen=True)
    35→class QueueBreakdown:
    36→    """All numbers needed to render the standardized queue display."""
    37→
    38→    queue_total: int = 0
    39→    plan_ordered: int = 0
    40→    skipped: int = 0
    41→    subjective: int = 0
    42→    workflow: int = 0
    43→    focus_cluster: str | None = None
    44→    focus_cluster_count: int = 0
    45→    focus_cluster_total: int = 0
    46→
    47→    @property
    48→    def objective_actionable(self) -> int:
    49→        """Objective items only — excludes subjective and workflow.
    50→
    51→        This is the count used by :func:`score_display_mode` to decide
    52→        frozen vs live display.  Do not use it directly for gating —
    53→        use ``score_display_mode()`` instead.
    54→        """
    55→        return max(0, self.queue_total - self.subjective - self.workflow)
    56→
    57→
    58→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    59→# ScoreDisplayMode — single decision point for frozen vs live score display
    60→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    61→
    62→class ScoreDisplayMode(enum.Enum):
    63→    """How to display the score given the current plan cycle and queue state.
    64→
    65→    - ``FROZEN``: objective work remains → show frozen plan-start score.
    66→    - ``PHASE_TRANSITION``: objective drained, subjective/workflow remain
    67→      → show live scores + transition banner.
    68→    - ``LIVE``: no active plan cycle or queue fully clear → show live scores.
    69→    """
    70→    FROZEN = "frozen"
    71→    PHASE_TRANSITION = "phase_transition"
    72→    LIVE = "live"
    73→
    74→
    75→def score_display_mode(
    76→    breakdown: QueueBreakdown | None,
    77→    plan_start_strict: float | None,
    78→) -> ScoreDisplayMode:
    79→    """Determine the score display mode from breakdown + plan-start score.
    80→
    81→    This is the **single source of truth** for the frozen-vs-live decision.
    82→    Every call site (status, scan reveal, next nudges, plan reconcile, plan
    83→    nudge) must use this instead of ad-hoc count checks.
    84→    """
    85→    if plan_start_strict is None:
    86→        return ScoreDisplayMode.LIVE
    87→    if breakdown is None:
    88→        return ScoreDisplayMode.LIVE
    89→    if breakdown.objective_actionable > 0:
    90→        return ScoreDisplayMode.FROZEN
    91→    if breakdown.queue_total > 0:
    92→        return ScoreDisplayMode.PHASE_TRANSITION
    93→    return ScoreDisplayMode.LIVE
    94→
    95→
    96→def plan_aware_queue_breakdown(
    97→    state: dict,
    98→    plan: dict | None = None,
    99→    *,
   100→    context: QueueContext | None = None,
   101→) -> QueueBreakdown:
   102→    """Build a full :class:`QueueBreakdown` from a single ``build_work_queue`` call.
   103→
   104→    When *context* is provided, its ``plan`` and ``policy`` are forwarded to
   105→    ``build_work_queue`` so the counts agree with the caller's resolution.
   106→    """
   107→    effective_plan = context.plan if context is not None else plan
   108→
   109→    result = work_queue_core_mod.build_work_queue(
   110→        state,
   111→        options=work_queue_core_mod.QueueBuildOptions(
   112→            status="open",
   113→            count=None,
   114→            plan=effective_plan if context is None else None,
   115→            include_skipped=False,
   116→            context=context,
   117→        ),
   118→    )
   119→
   120→    # Collapse clusters for display-level counting
   121→    items = result.get("items", [])
   122→    if effective_plan and not effective_plan.get("active_cluster"):
   123→        items = collapse_clusters(items, effective_plan)
   124→
   125→    queue_total = len(items)
   126→
   127→    # Count subjective and workflow items in the queue.
   128→    # Collapsed clusters whose members are all subjective count as subjective.
   129→    subjective = sum(
   130→        1 for item in items
   131→        if is_subjective_queue_item(item)
   132→    )
   133→    workflow = sum(
   134→        1 for item in items
   135→        if item.get("kind") in ("workflow_stage", "workflow_action")
   136→    )
   137→
   138→    # Plan-derived counts
   139→    plan_ordered = 0
   140→    skipped = 0
   141→    if effective_plan:
   142→        skipped = len(effective_plan.get("skipped", {}))
   143→        # plan_ordered = items that are in queue_order minus skipped
   144→        queue_order = effective_plan.get("queue_order", [])
   145→        skipped_ids = set(effective_plan.get("skipped", {}).keys())
   146→        plan_ordered = sum(1 for fid in queue_order if fid not in skipped_ids)
   147→
   148→    # Focus cluster info
   149→    focus_cluster = None
   150→    focus_cluster_count = 0
   151→    focus_cluster_total = 0
   152→    if effective_plan:
   153→        active = effective_plan.get("active_cluster")
   154→        if active:
   155→            focus_cluster = active
   156→            cluster_data = effective_plan.get("clusters", {}).get(active, {})
   157→            focus_cluster_total = len(cluster_data.get("issue_ids", []))
   158→            # Count how many cluster members are still in the queue
   159→            cluster_member_ids = set(cluster_data.get("issue_ids", []))
   160→            open_issues = {
   161→                fid
   162→                for fid, f in state.get("issues", {}).items()
   163→                if f.get("status") == "open"
   164→            }
   165→            focus_cluster_count = len(cluster_member_ids & open_issues)
   166→
   167→    return QueueBreakdown(
   168→        queue_total=queue_total,
   169→        plan_ordered=plan_ordered,
   170→        skipped=skipped,
   171→        subjective=subjective,
   172→        workflow=workflow,
   173→        focus_cluster=focus_cluster,
   174→        focus_cluster_count=focus_cluster_count,
   175→        focus_cluster_total=focus_cluster_total,
   176→    )
   177→

   266→def show_score_with_plan_context(state: dict, prev) -> None:
   267→    """Load plan (best-effort) and show frozen or live score context.
   268→
   269→    Encapsulates the common load_plan + PLAN_LOAD_EXCEPTIONS + reveal
   270→    choreography so command modules don't each repeat it.
   271→    """

   274→    except PLAN_LOAD_EXCEPTIONS as exc:
   275→        _logger.debug("score display skipped plan-aware context", exc_info=exc)
   276→        plan = None
   277→    print_execution_or_reveal(state, prev, plan)
   278→
```

```
    55→    - No unscored (placeholder) subjective dimensions remain
    56→    - ``workflow::score-checkpoint`` is not already in the queue
    57→

    81→    - ``workflow::create-plan`` is not already in the queue
```

```
1→"""Post-scan plan reconciliation — handle issue churn."""
     2→
     3→from __future__ import annotations
     4→
     5→from dataclasses import dataclass, field
     6→from datetime import UTC, datetime, timedelta
     7→
     8→from desloppify.engine._plan.annotations import get_issue_note
     9→from desloppify.engine._plan.constants import SYNTHETIC_PREFIXES
    10→from desloppify.engine._plan.operations_meta import append_log_entry
    11→from desloppify.engine._plan.operations_skip import resurface_stale_skips
    12→from desloppify.engine._plan.promoted_ids import prune_promoted_ids
    13→from desloppify.engine._plan.reconcile_review_import import (
    14→    ReviewImportSyncResult,
    15→    sync_plan_after_review_import,
    16→)

    18→    EPIC_PREFIX,
    19→    PlanModel,
    20→    SupersededEntry,
    21→    ensure_plan_defaults,
    22→)
    23→from desloppify.engine._state.schema import StateModel, utc_now
    24→
    25→SUPERSEDED_TTL_DAYS = 90
    26→
    27→
    28→@dataclass
    29→class ReconcileResult:
    30→    """Summary of changes made during reconciliation."""
    31→
    32→    superseded: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    33→    pruned: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    34→    resurfaced: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    35→    clusters_completed: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)
    36→    changes: int = 0
    37→
    38→
    39→def _find_candidates(
    40→    state: StateModel, detector: str, file: str
    41→) -> list[str]:
    42→    """Find open issues that could be remaps for a disappeared issue."""
    43→    candidates: list[str] = []
    44→    for fid, issue in state.get("issues", {}).items():
    45→        if issue.get("status") != "open":
    46→            continue
    47→        if issue.get("detector") == detector and issue.get("file") == file:
    48→            candidates.append(fid)
    49→    return candidates
    50→
    51→
    52→def _is_issue_alive(state: StateModel, issue_id: str) -> bool:
    53→    """Return True if the issue exists and is open."""
    54→    issue = state.get("issues", {}).get(issue_id)
    55→    if issue is None:
    56→        return False
    57→    return issue.get("status") == "open"
    58→
    59→
    60→def _supersede_id(
    61→    plan: PlanModel,
    62→    state: StateModel,
    63→    issue_id: str,
    64→    now: str,
    65→) -> bool:
    66→    """Move a disappeared issue to superseded. Returns True if changed."""
    67→    issue = state.get("issues", {}).get(issue_id)
    68→    detector = ""
    69→    file = ""
    70→    summary = ""
    71→    if issue:
    72→        detector = issue.get("detector", "")
    73→        file = issue.get("file", "")
    74→        summary = issue.get("summary", "")
    75→
    76→    candidates = _find_candidates(state, detector, file) if detector else []
    77→    # Don't include the original in candidates
    78→    candidates = [c for c in candidates if c != issue_id]
    79→
    80→    entry: SupersededEntry = {
    81→        "original_id": issue_id,
    82→        "original_detector": detector,
    83→        "original_file": file,
    84→        "original_summary": summary,
    85→        "status": "superseded",
    86→        "superseded_at": now,
    87→        "remapped_to": None,
    88→        "candidates": candidates[:5],
    89→    }
    90→
    91→    # Preserve any existing override note
    92→    override_note = get_issue_note(plan, issue_id)
    93→    if override_note:
    94→        entry["note"] = override_note
    95→
    96→    plan["superseded"][issue_id] = entry
    97→
    98→    # Remove from queue_order, skipped, promoted_ids, cluster issue_ids
    99→    order: list[str] = plan.get("queue_order", [])
   100→    skipped: dict = plan.get("skipped", {})
   101→    if issue_id in order:
   102→        order.remove(issue_id)
   103→    skipped.pop(issue_id, None)
   104→    prune_promoted_ids(plan, {issue_id})
   105→    for cluster in plan.get("clusters", {}).values():
   106→        ids = cluster.get("issue_ids", [])
   107→        if issue_id in ids:
   108→            ids.remove(issue_id)
   109→
   110→    # Clear stale cluster reference from override
   111→    override = plan.get("overrides", {}).get(issue_id)
   112→    if override and override.get("cluster"):
   113→        override["cluster"] = None
   114→        override["updated_at"] = now
   115→
   116→    return True
   117→
   118→
   119→def _prune_old_superseded(plan: PlanModel, now_dt: datetime) -> list[str]:
   120→    """Remove superseded entries older than TTL. Returns pruned IDs."""
   121→    superseded = plan.get("superseded", {})
   122→    cutoff = now_dt - timedelta(days=SUPERSEDED_TTL_DAYS)
   123→    to_prune: list[str] = []
   124→
   125→    for fid, entry in superseded.items():
   126→        ts = entry.get("superseded_at", "")
   127→        try:
   128→            entry_dt = datetime.fromisoformat(ts)
   129→            if entry_dt.tzinfo is None:
   130→                entry_dt = entry_dt.replace(tzinfo=UTC)
   131→            if entry_dt < cutoff:
   132→                to_prune.append(fid)
   133→        except (ValueError, TypeError):
   134→            to_prune.append(fid)
   135→
   136→    for fid in to_prune:
   137→        superseded.pop(fid, None)
   138→        # Also clean up stale overrides
   139→        plan.get("overrides", {}).pop(fid, None)
   140→
   141→    return to_prune
   142→
   143→
   144→def reconcile_plan_after_scan(
   145→    plan: PlanModel,
   146→    state: StateModel,
   147→) -> ReconcileResult:
   148→    """Reconcile plan against current state after a scan.
   149→
   150→    Finds IDs referenced in the plan that no longer exist or are no longer
   151→    open, moves them to superseded, and prunes old superseded entries.
   152→    """
   153→    ensure_plan_defaults(plan)
   154→    result = ReconcileResult()
   155→    now = utc_now()
   156→    now_dt = datetime.now(UTC)
   157→
   158→    # Collect all issue IDs referenced by the plan
   159→    referenced_ids: set[str] = set()
   160→    referenced_ids.update(plan.get("queue_order", []))
   161→    referenced_ids.update(plan.get("skipped", {}).keys())
   162→    for override_id in plan.get("overrides", {}):
   163→        referenced_ids.add(override_id)
   164→    for cluster in plan.get("clusters", {}).values():
   165→        referenced_ids.update(cluster.get("issue_ids", []))
   166→
   167→    # Exclude already-superseded IDs and synthetic IDs (managed by stale_dimensions)
   168→    already_superseded = set(plan.get("superseded", {}).keys())
   169→    referenced_ids -= already_superseded
   170→    referenced_ids = {
   171→        fid for fid in referenced_ids
   172→        if not any(fid.startswith(prefix) for prefix in SYNTHETIC_PREFIXES)
   173→    }
   174→
   175→    # Snapshot non-epic cluster sizes before superseding so we can detect
   176→    # clusters that become empty (all issues resolved by scan).
   177→    clusters = plan.get("clusters", {})
   178→    pre_sizes: dict[str, int] = {
   179→        name: len(cluster.get("issue_ids", []))
   180→        for name, cluster in clusters.items()
   181→        if not name.startswith(EPIC_PREFIX)
   182→    }
   183→
   184→    # Check each referenced ID
   185→    for fid in sorted(referenced_ids):
   186→        if not _is_issue_alive(state, fid):
   187→            if _supersede_id(plan, state, fid, now):
   188→                result.superseded.append(fid)
   189→                result.changes += 1
   190→
   191→    # Detect manual clusters that just became empty (all issues auto-resolved).
   192→    # Log cluster_done so the plan tracks completion the same way as user resolves.
   193→    for name, prev_size in pre_sizes.items():
   194→        if prev_size == 0:
   195→            continue  # was already empty
   196→        cluster = clusters.get(name)
   197→        if cluster is None:
   198→            continue
   199→        if len(cluster.get("issue_ids", [])) == 0:
   200→            result.clusters_completed.append(name)
   201→            append_log_entry(
   202→                plan,
   203→                "cluster_done",
   204→                issue_ids=[],
   205→                cluster_name=name,
   206→                actor="system",
   207→                detail={"reason": "all issues resolved by scan"},
   208→            )
   209→            result.changes += 1
   210→
   211→    # Reconcile epic clusters: remove dead issues, delete empty epics
   212→    clusters = plan.get("clusters", {})
   213→    epic_names_to_delete: list[str] = []
   214→    for name, cluster in list(clusters.items()):
   215→        if not name.startswith(EPIC_PREFIX):
   216→            continue
   217→        issue_ids = cluster.get("issue_ids", [])
   218→        alive_ids = [fid for fid in issue_ids if _is_issue_alive(state, fid)]
   219→        if alive_ids != issue_ids:
   220→            cluster["issue_ids"] = alive_ids
   221→            result.changes += 1
   222→        if not alive_ids:
   223→            epic_names_to_delete.append(name)
   224→    for name in epic_names_to_delete:
   225→        clusters.pop(name, None)
   226→        result.changes += 1
   227→
   228→    # Resurface stale temporary skips
   229→    scan_count = state.get("scan_count", 0)
   230→
   231→    resurfaced = resurface_stale_skips(plan, scan_count)
   232→    if resurfaced:
   233→        result.resurfaced = resurfaced
   234→        result.changes += len(resurfaced)
   235→
   236→    # Prune old superseded entries
   237→    pruned = _prune_old_superseded(plan, now_dt)
   238→    result.pruned = pruned
   239→    result.changes += len(pruned)
   240→
   241→    # Log reconciliation if any changes were made
   242→    if result.changes > 0:
   243→        append_log_entry(
   244→            plan,
   245→            "reconcile",
   246→            issue_ids=result.superseded,
```

```
1→"""Shared helpers for queue-sync decisions.
     2→
     3→Every sync module (``sync_triage``, ``sync_dimensions``, ``sync_workflow``,
     4→``auto_cluster_sync``) needs to answer two questions:
     5→
     6→1. **Is there an objective backlog?**  (Should we defer optional items?)
     7→2. **Are we mid-cycle?**  (Has a queue cycle started and not yet completed?)
     8→
     9→This module provides a single definition of each so the logic stays
    10→consistent and changes propagate everywhere at once.
    11→"""
    12→
    13→from __future__ import annotations
    14→
    15→from desloppify.engine._plan.schema import PlanModel
    16→from desloppify.engine._plan.subjective_policy import (
    17→    NON_OBJECTIVE_DETECTORS as _NON_OBJECTIVE_DETECTORS,
    18→)
    19→from desloppify.engine._plan.subjective_policy import (
    20→    SubjectiveVisibility,
    21→)
    22→from desloppify.engine._state.schema import StateModel
    23→
    24→
    25→def has_objective_backlog(
    26→    state_or_issues: StateModel | dict,
    27→    policy: SubjectiveVisibility | None,
    28→) -> bool:
    29→    """Return whether an objective backlog exists (open non-subjective issues).
    30→
    31→    Prefers the pre-computed *policy* snapshot when available.
    32→    Falls back to scanning *state_or_issues* directly — accepts either a
    33→    full ``StateModel`` (looks up ``issues``) or a raw issues dict.
    34→    """
    35→    if policy is not None:
    36→        return policy.has_objective_backlog
    37→
    38→    # Accept either full state payload (`{"issues": ...}`) or raw issues dict.
    39→    issues = state_or_issues
    40→    if isinstance(state_or_issues, dict):
    41→        maybe_issues = state_or_issues.get("issues")
    42→        if isinstance(maybe_issues, dict):
    43→            issues = maybe_issues
    44→    return any(
    45→        f.get("status") == "open"
    46→        and f.get("detector") not in _NON_OBJECTIVE_DETECTORS
    47→        and not f.get("suppressed")
    48→        for f in issues.values()
    49→    )
    50→
    51→
    52→def is_mid_cycle(plan: PlanModel) -> bool:
    53→    """True when a queue cycle is in progress.
    54→
    55→    A cycle is active when ``plan_start_scores`` is set to real score
    56→    values.  The ``{"reset": True}`` sentinel (set by lifecycle reset)
    57→    does NOT count as mid-cycle — it means "seed real scores on next scan".
    58→    """
    59→    scores = plan.get("plan_start_scores")
    60→    return bool(scores) and not (isinstance(scores, dict) and scores.get("reset"))
    61→
    62→
    63→__all__ = ["has_objective_backlog", "is_mid_cycle"]
    64→
```

```
1→"""Unified subjective-visibility policy.
     2→
     3→A single frozen dataclass computed once per operation replaces the scattered
     4→``has_objective_items`` / ``objective_count`` computations in
     5→``stale_dimensions`` and ``auto_cluster``.
     6→"""
     7→
     8→from __future__ import annotations
     9→
    10→from dataclasses import dataclass
    11→
    12→from desloppify.base.config import DEFAULT_TARGET_STRICT_SCORE
    13→from desloppify.base.enums import Status
    14→from desloppify.base.registry import DETECTORS
    15→from desloppify.engine._state.filtering import issue_in_scan_scope
    16→from desloppify.engine._state.schema import StateModel
    17→from desloppify.engine.planning.helpers import CONFIDENCE_ORDER
    18→
    19→# Detectors whose issues are NOT objective mechanical work.
    20→NON_OBJECTIVE_DETECTORS: frozenset[str] = frozenset({
    21→    "review", "concerns", "subjective_review", "subjective_assessment",
    22→})
    23→
    24→
    25→@dataclass(frozen=True)
    26→class SubjectiveVisibility:
    27→    """Immutable snapshot of the subjective-vs-objective balance."""
    28→
    29→    has_objective_backlog: bool  # any open non-subjective issues?
    30→    objective_count: int  # how many
    31→    unscored_ids: frozenset[str]  # subjective::* IDs needing initial review
    32→    stale_ids: frozenset[str]  # subjective::* IDs needing re-review
    33→    under_target_ids: frozenset[str]  # below target, not stale/unscored
    34→
    35→    def should_inject_to_plan(self, fid: str) -> bool:
    36→        """Should this subjective ID be injected into plan queue_order?"""
    37→        if fid in self.unscored_ids:
    38→            return True  # unconditional
    39→        if fid in self.stale_ids:
    40→            return not self.has_objective_backlog
    41→        if fid in self.under_target_ids:
    42→            return not self.has_objective_backlog
    43→        return False
    44→
    45→    def should_evict_from_plan(self, fid: str) -> bool:
    46→        """Should this subjective ID be removed from plan queue_order?"""
    47→        if fid in self.unscored_ids:
    48→            return False  # never evict unscored
    49→        if fid in self.stale_ids or fid in self.under_target_ids:
    50→            return self.has_objective_backlog
    51→        return False
    52→
    53→    @property
    54→    def backlog_blocks_rerun(self) -> bool:
    55→        """Preflight: should reruns be blocked?"""
    56→        return self.has_objective_backlog
    57→
    58→
    59→def _is_evidence_only(issue: dict) -> bool:
    60→    """Return True if the issue is below its detector's standalone threshold."""
    61→    detector = issue.get("detector", "")
    62→    meta = DETECTORS.get(detector)
    63→    if meta and meta.standalone_threshold:
    64→        threshold_rank = CONFIDENCE_ORDER.get(meta.standalone_threshold, 9)
    65→        issue_rank = CONFIDENCE_ORDER.get(issue.get("confidence", "low"), 9)
    66→        if issue_rank > threshold_rank:
    67→            return True
    68→    return False
    69→
    70→
    71→class _ScanPathFromStatePolicy:
    72→    """Sentinel type: resolve scan_path from state."""
    73→
    74→
    75→_SCAN_PATH_FROM_STATE_POLICY = _ScanPathFromStatePolicy()
    76→ScanPathPolicyOption = str | None | _ScanPathFromStatePolicy
    77→
    78→
    79→def compute_subjective_visibility(
    80→    state: StateModel,
    81→    *,
    82→    target_strict: float = DEFAULT_TARGET_STRICT_SCORE,
    83→    scan_path: ScanPathPolicyOption = _SCAN_PATH_FROM_STATE_POLICY,
    84→    plan: dict | None = None,
    85→) -> SubjectiveVisibility:
    86→    """Build the policy snapshot from current state.
    87→
    88→    *scan_path* defaults to ``state["scan_path"]`` so callers don't need to
    89→    thread it manually.  Pass an explicit ``str`` to override, or ``None``
    90→    to disable scope filtering.  When *plan* is set, issues whose IDs
    91→    appear in ``plan["skipped"]`` are excluded.
    92→
    93→    Imports policy helpers from ``stale_policy`` so this module remains
    94→    side-effect free and cycle-safe.
    95→    """
    96→    from desloppify.engine._plan.stale_policy import (
    97→        current_stale_ids,
    98→        current_under_target_ids,
    99→        current_unscored_ids,
   100→    )
   101→
   102→    resolved_scan_path: str | None = (
   103→        state.get("scan_path")
   104→        if isinstance(scan_path, _ScanPathFromStatePolicy)
   105→        else scan_path
   106→    )
   107→
   108→    issues = state.get("issues", {})
   109→    skipped_ids = set((plan or {}).get("skipped", {}).keys())
   110→
   111→    # Count open, non-suppressed, objective issues.
   112→    # Evidence-only issues (below standalone confidence threshold) are
   113→    # excluded — they still affect scores but are not actionable queue items.
   114→    # Issues outside scan_path and plan-skipped issues are also excluded
   115→    # so the policy matches what the user actually sees in the queue.
   116→    objective_count = sum(
   117→        1
   118→        for issue_id, issue in issues.items()
   119→        if issue.get("status") == Status.OPEN
   120→        and issue.get("detector") not in NON_OBJECTIVE_DETECTORS
   121→        and not issue.get("suppressed")
   122→        and not _is_evidence_only(issue)
   123→        and issue_in_scan_scope(str(issue.get("file", "")), resolved_scan_path)
   124→        and issue_id not in skipped_ids
   125→    )
   126→
   127→    unscored = current_unscored_ids(state)
   128→    stale = current_stale_ids(state)
   129→    under_target = current_under_target_ids(state, target_strict=target_strict)
   130→
   131→    return SubjectiveVisibility(
   132→        has_objective_backlog=objective_count > 0,
   133→        objective_count=objective_count,
   134→        unscored_ids=frozenset(unscored),
   135→        stale_ids=frozenset(stale),
   136→        under_target_ids=frozenset(under_target),
   137→    )
   138→
   139→
   140→__all__ = [
   141→    "NON_OBJECTIVE_DETECTORS",
   142→    "SubjectiveVisibility",
   143→    "compute_subjective_visibility",
   144→]
   145→
```

```
   104→    2. Score     — estimate impact from dimension headroom
   105→    3. Presort   — stamp plan positions, separate skipped items
   106→    4. Lifecycle — filter endgame-only items when objective work remains
   107→    5. Sort      — rank by impact/confidence, apply plan order
   108→    6. Limit     — truncate to count, optionally add explain metadata
   109→    """
   110→    opts = options or QueueBuildOptions()

   114→    items = build_issue_items(
   115→        state, scan_path=scan_path, status_filter=status,
   116→        scope=opts.scope, chronic=opts.chronic,

   118→    items += _gather_subjective_items(state, opts, threshold)
   119→    items += _gather_workflow_items(state, plan, status)
```

```
    67→def _show_scan_visibility(noise, effective_include_slow: bool) -> None:
    68→    """Print fast-scan and noise budget visibility hints.
    69→
    70→    Side-effect only: conditionally prints scan-mode warnings to stdout.
    71→    All branches may be skipped (full scan, no noise budget hit, no hidden
    72→    issues), so the function can legitimately produce no output.
    73→    """
    74→    if not effective_include_slow:
    75→        print(colorize("  * Fast scan — slow phases (duplicates) skipped", "yellow"))
    76→    if noise.budget_warning:
    77→        print(colorize(f"  * {noise.budget_warning}", "yellow"))

    99→        remediation = str(entry.get("remediation", "")).strip()
```

```
   202→def _apply_assessment_reset(payload: dict, *, source: str, now: str) -> None:
   203→    """Apply a standard reset mutation to a single subjective assessment payload.
   204→
   205→    Sets score to 0.0, stamps assessed_at/reset_by/placeholder, and strips
   206→    any cached scoring artifacts (integrity_penalty, components,
   207→    component_scores) plus provisional-override markers.
   208→    """
   209→    payload["score"] = 0.0
   210→    payload["source"] = source
   211→    payload["assessed_at"] = now
   212→    payload["reset_by"] = source
   213→    payload["placeholder"] = True
   214→    payload.pop("integrity_penalty", None)
   215→    payload.pop("components", None)
   216→    payload.pop("component_scores", None)
   217→    payload.pop("provisional_override", None)
   218→    payload.pop("provisional_until_scan", None)

   221→def _reset_subjective_assessments_for_scan_reset(
   222→    state: state_mod.StateModel,
   223→    *,

   228→
   229→    reset_keys = {
   230→        key.strip()
   231→        for key in assessments

   233→    }
   234→    reset_keys.update(_subjective_reset_dimensions(lang_name=lang_name))
   235→
   236→    now = state_mod.utc_now()
   237→    source = "scan_reset_subjective"
   238→    for key in sorted(reset_keys):
   239→        payload = assessments.get(key)
   240→        if isinstance(payload, dict):
   241→            _apply_assessment_reset(payload, source=source, now=now)
   242→            continue
   243→        assessments[key] = {
   244→            "score": 0.0,
   245→            "source": source,
   246→            "assessed_at": now,
   247→            "reset_by": source,
   248→            "placeholder": True,
   249→        }
   250→    return len(reset_keys)
```

```
   419→        runtime.state_path,
   420→        subjective_integrity_target=target_score,
   421→    )
   422→
   423→    _clear_needs_rescan_flag(runtime.config)
   424→    _reconcile_plan_post_scan(runtime)
   425→
   426→    return ScanMergeResult(
   427→        diff=diff,
   428→        prev_overall=prev.overall,
   429→        prev_objective=prev.objective,
   430→        prev_strict=prev.strict,
   431→        prev_verified=prev.verified,
   432→        prev_dim_scores=prev_dim_scores,
   433→    )
   434→
   435→
   436→def resolve_noise_snapshot(
   437→    state: state_mod.StateModel,
   438→    config: dict[str, object],
   439→) -> ScanNoiseSnapshot:
   440→    """Resolve noise budget settings and hidden issue counters."""
   441→    noise_budget, global_noise_budget, budget_warning = (
   442→        state_mod.resolve_issue_noise_settings(config)
   443→    )
   444→    issues_by_id = _state_issues(state)
   445→    open_issues = [
   446→        issue
   447→        for issue in state_mod.path_scoped_issues(
   448→            issues_by_id, state.get("scan_path")
   449→        ).values()
   450→        if issue.get("status") == "open"
   451→    ]
   452→    _, hidden_by_detector = state_mod.apply_issue_noise_budget(
   453→        open_issues,
   454→        budget=noise_budget,
   455→        global_budget=global_noise_budget,
   456→    )
   457→
   458→    return ScanNoiseSnapshot(
   459→        noise_budget=noise_budget,
   460→        global_noise_budget=global_noise_budget,
   461→        budget_warning=budget_warning,
   462→        hidden_by_detector=hidden_by_detector,
   463→        hidden_total=sum(hidden_by_detector.values()),
   464→    )
   465→
   466→
   467→def persist_reminder_history(
   468→    runtime: ScanRuntime,
   469→    narrative: dict[str, object],
   470→) -> None:
   471→    """Persist reminder history emitted by narrative computation."""
   472→    if not (narrative and "reminder_history" in narrative):
   473→        return
   474→
   475→    runtime.state["reminder_history"] = narrative["reminder_history"]
   476→    target_score = target_strict_score_from_config(runtime.config)
   477→    state_mod.save_state(
   478→        runtime.state,
   479→        runtime.state_path,
   480→        subjective_integrity_target=target_score,
   481→    )
```

```
    23→def _consecutive_subjective_integrity_status(
    24→    state: StateModel, status: str
    25→) -> int:
    26→    """Return consecutive trailing scans with the given subjective-integrity status."""
    27→    history = state.get("scan_history", [])
    28→    if not isinstance(history, list):
    29→        return 0
    30→
    31→    streak = 0
    32→    for entry in reversed(history):
    33→        if not isinstance(entry, dict):
    34→            break
    35→        integrity = entry.get("subjective_integrity")
    36→        if not isinstance(integrity, dict):
    37→            break
    38→        if integrity.get("status") != status:
    39→            break
    40→        streak += 1
    41→    return streak

    44→def _show_score_reveal(
    45→    state: StateModel,
    46→    new: state_mod.ScoreSnapshot,
    47→    *,
    48→    target_strict: float | None = None,
    49→) -> None:
    50→    """Show before/after score comparison when a queue cycle just completed.
    51→
    52→    This fires when the plan had ``plan_start_scores`` and the queue was empty
    53→    at scan time (i.e. the reconcile block cleared plan_start_scores).  We detect
    54→    this by checking the plan *before* the clear happened — since merge_scan_results
    55→    clears it, we peek at the ``_last_score_reveal`` stash it leaves behind.
    56→    """
    57→    # scan_workflow stashes the old plan_start_scores on state as a transient
    58→    # key when it clears them (queue empty).  Pop it here for the reveal.
    59→    plan_start = state.pop("_plan_start_scores_for_reveal", None)
    60→    if not isinstance(plan_start, dict) or not plan_start.get("strict"):
    61→        return
    62→
    63→    old_strict = float(plan_start["strict"])
    64→    new_strict = float(new.strict or 0)
    65→    delta = round(new_strict - old_strict, 1)
    66→    delta_str = f" ({'+' if delta > 0 else ''}{delta:.1f})" if abs(delta) >= 0.05 else ""
    67→
    68→    bar = "=" * 50
    69→    print(colorize(f"  {bar}", "cyan"))
    70→    print(colorize("  SCORE UPDATE — Queue cycle complete!", "bold"))
    71→    print(colorize(f"  Plan-start: strict {old_strict:.1f}/100", "dim"))
    72→    print(colorize(f"  Updated:    strict {new_strict:.1f}/100{delta_str}", "cyan"))
    73→    if target_strict is not None:
    74→        target_gap = round(target_strict - new_strict, 1)

    77→        else:

    79→    print(colorize(f"  {bar}", "cyan"))

   114→def _unscored_subjective_callout(state: StateModel) -> None:
   115→    """Print a callout when subjective dimensions are unassessed, clarifying score composition."""
   116→    dim_scores = state.get("dimension_scores", {})
   117→    if not dim_scores:
   118→        return
   119→
   120→    total_subj = 0
   121→    unscored_subj = 0
   122→    for data in dim_scores.values():
   123→        if not isinstance(data, dict):
   124→            continue
   125→        detectors = data.get("detectors", {})
   126→        if "subjective_assessment" not in detectors:
   127→            continue
   128→        total_subj += 1
   129→        meta = detectors.get("subjective_assessment", {})
   130→        if isinstance(meta, dict) and meta.get("placeholder"):
   131→            unscored_subj += 1
   132→
   133→    if unscored_subj == 0 or total_subj == 0:
   134→        return
   135→
   136→    # Get the subjective weight fraction from the scoring breakdown
   137→    try:
   138→        import desloppify.engine._scoring.results.core as scoring_mod
   139→        breakdown = scoring_mod.compute_health_breakdown(dim_scores)
   140→        subj_pct = round(float(breakdown.get("subjective_fraction", 0.0) or 0.0) * 100)
   141→    except (ImportError, TypeError, ValueError):
   142→        subj_pct = 0
   143→
   144→    if unscored_subj == total_subj:
   145→        msg = (
   146→            f"  ⚠ {unscored_subj} subjective dimension{'s' if unscored_subj != 1 else ''} "
   147→            f"{'are' if unscored_subj != 1 else 'is'} unassessed (scored as 0). "
   148→        )
   149→        if subj_pct:
   150→            msg += (
   151→                f"The strict score currently reflects only mechanical detectors "
   152→                f"({100 - subj_pct}% of score weight). "
   153→            )
   154→        msg += "Run `desloppify review --prepare` to assess."
   155→    else:
   156→        msg = (
   157→            f"  ⚠ {unscored_subj} of {total_subj} subjective dimensions unassessed (scored as 0). "
   158→            f"Strict score is lower than expected until these are reviewed."
   159→        )
   160→    print(colorize(msg, "yellow"))
```

## Work Queue Drainage Flow - Complete Research Report

Based on my thorough exploration of the desloppify codebase, here's the complete flow for what happens when the work queue is cleared/drained:

### 1. **Queue Drainage Triggers Rescan & Subjective Analysis Cycle**

The flow is triggered by the **post-scan plan reconciliation** in `reconcile_plan_post_scan()` (called from `merge_scan_results()` at `/Users/user_c042661f/Documents/desloppify/desloppify/app/commands/scan/workflow.py:424`).

**Key insight:** The queue lifecycle is divided into two **phases**:
- **Objective phase**: Mechanical detectors (fixes, issues, refactoring) 
- **Endgame/Subjective phase**: Subjective dimensions, triage, workflow checkpoints

Once all objective work is drained from the queue, the system automatically:
1. Injects subjective dimension reviews for initial assessment
2. Runs triage workflow stages (observe, reflect, organize, enrich, sense-check, commit)
3. Injects communication checkpoints and plan-creation workflows

---

### 2. **`_clear_plan_start_scores_if_queue_empty()` - The Queue Drainage Gate**

**File:** `/Users/user_c042661f/Documents/desloppify/desloppify/app/commands/scan/plan_reconcile.py:129-153`

This function:

```python
def _clear_plan_start_scores_if_queue_empty(state, plan) -> bool:
    """Clear plan-start score snapshot once the queue is fully drained."""
```

**What it gates:**
- Determines when to **"unfreeze" the scores** — moving from FROZEN display mode to LIVE mode
- Uses `score_display_mode(breakdown, frozen_strict)` to check if queue is truly empty
- When queue is drained: stashes old scores in `state["_plan_start_scores_for_reveal"]` and clears `plan["plan_start_scores"]`

**Return value:** `True` if it cleared the scores (queue was empty), `False` if queue still has work

---

### 3. **`sync_communicate_score_needed()` & `sync_create_plan_needed()` - Workflow Gates**

**File:** `/Users/user_c042661f/Documents/desloppify/desloppify/engine/_plan/sync_workflow.py:70-149`

#### `sync_communicate_score_needed(plan, state, policy=None)` (lines 126-149)
- **Triggers when:** All initial subjective reviews are complete (no unscored dimensions) OR scores were just imported
- **Effect:** Injects `workflow::communicate-score` queue item to show final scores
- **Guard:** Only if no checkpoint or communicate-score already present

#### `sync_create_plan_needed(plan, state, policy=None)` (lines 70-99)
- **Triggers when:**
  1. No unscored (placeholder) subjective dimensions remain ✓
  2. At least one objective issue exists ✓
  3. No triage stages pending ✓
  4. `workflow::create-plan` not already in queue
- **Effect:** Injects `workflow::create-plan` queue item to rebuild the prioritized plan
- **Guard:** Blocked by `has_objective_backlog()` check — defers until objective work is drained

**Key concept:** These workflow items don't appear until endgame conditions are met.

---

### 4. **`score_display_mode()` - Single Source of Truth for Queue Emptiness**

**File:** `/Users/user_c042661f/Documents/desloppify/desloppify/app/commands/helpers/queue_progress.py:75-93`

```python
def score_display_mode(breakdown: QueueBreakdown | None, 
                       plan_start_strict: float | None) -> ScoreDisplayMode:
```

**Returns three modes:**

| Mode | Condition | Display |
|------|-----------|---------|
| `FROZEN` | `plan_start_strict is not None` AND `breakdown.objective_actionable > 0` | Show frozen plan-start score + progress bar |
| `PHASE_TRANSITION` | Queue has subjective/workflow items but NO objective items | Show live scores + transition banner |
| `LIVE` | `plan_start_strict is None` OR queue is completely empty | Show normal live scores |

**Key metric:** `breakdown.objective_actionable` = `queue_total - subjective - workflow`
- This is the count used to decide frozen vs live display
- Does NOT include endgame-only items (subjective dimensions, workflow stages)

**Rules:**

### 11. **Constants: The Workflow Item IDs**

**File:** `/Users/user_c042661f/Documents/desloppify/desloppify/engine/_plan/constants.py:22-26`


**Queue lifecycle order:**
1. Initial reviews → `score-checkpoint` (all unscored done)
2. Reviews complete → `communicate-score` (show scores)
3. Ready for prioritization → `create-plan` (when objective work exists)
4. Triage workflow (optional, deferred if objective work remains)

### Summary

The **queue drainage flow** is a sophisticated lifecycle system:

1. **Cycle starts:** `_seed_plan_start_scores()` freezes scores, marks plan as mid-cycle
2. **User works:** `apply_lifecycle_filter()` hides endgame items while objective work exists
3. **Objective drained:** Subjective items + workflow stages become visible
4. **Reviews complete:** `sync_communicate_score_needed()` injects communication checkpoint
5. **Plan rebuild:** `sync_create_plan_needed()` prepares final prioritized plan
6. **Cycle ends:** `_clear_plan_start_scores_if_queue_empty()` clears frozen scores, triggers reveal
7. **Scores updated:** `show_score_reveal()` shows before/after delta

The key insight: **`score_display_mode()` is the single source of truth** for determining when the queue is truly drained. All gating logic flows from `breakdown.objective_actionable > 0`.

```
   111→       ``queue_order``.  Never reorders existing items.
   112→    """
   113→    ensure_plan_defaults(plan)
   114→    result = QueueSyncResult()
   115→
   116→    # Mid-cycle: don't inject unscored dimensions — they'll surface at cycle end.
   117→    if is_mid_cycle(plan):
   118→        return result
   119→
   120→    unscored_ids = current_unscored_ids(state)
   121→    stale_ids = stale_policy_mod.current_stale_ids(
   122→        state, subjective_prefix=SUBJECTIVE_PREFIX,
   123→    )
   124→    order: list[str] = plan["queue_order"]
   125→
   126→    # --- Cleanup: prune subjective IDs that are no longer unscored --------
   127→    # Only prune IDs that are neither unscored nor stale (stale sync owns those).
   128→    _prune_subjective_ids(order, keep_ids=unscored_ids | stale_ids, pruned=result.pruned)
   129→
   130→    # --- Inject: append unscored IDs to back of queue ---------------------
   131→    _inject_subjective_ids(order, inject_ids=unscored_ids, injected=result.injected)
   132→
   133→    return result
   134→
   135→
   136→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   137→# Stale dimension sync (back of queue, conditional)
   138→# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   139→
   140→def sync_stale_dimensions(
   141→    plan: PlanModel,
   142→    state: StateModel,
   143→    *,
   144→    policy: SubjectiveVisibility | None = None,
   145→    cycle_just_completed: bool = False,
   146→) -> QueueSyncResult:
   147→    """Keep the plan queue in sync with stale and under-target subjective dimensions.
   148→
   149→    1. Remove any ``subjective::*`` IDs from ``queue_order`` that are no
   150→       longer stale/under-target and not unscored (avoids pruning IDs owned
   151→       by ``sync_unscored_dimensions``).
   152→       When objective backlog exists (and this is not a just-completed cycle),
   153→       stale/under-target IDs are also evicted so they do not block objective work.
   154→    2. Append stale and under-target dimension IDs to the *back* when either:
   155→       a. No objective items remain (mid-cycle), OR
   156→       b. A cycle just completed.
   157→       Never reorders existing items.
   158→    """
   159→    ensure_plan_defaults(plan)
   160→    result = QueueSyncResult()
   161→    stale_ids = stale_policy_mod.current_stale_ids(
   162→        state, subjective_prefix=SUBJECTIVE_PREFIX,
   163→    )
   164→    under_target_ids = current_under_target_ids(state)
   165→    injectable_ids = stale_ids | under_target_ids
   166→    unscored_ids = current_unscored_ids(state)
   167→    order: list[str] = plan["queue_order"]
   168→
   169→    objective_backlog = has_objective_backlog(state, policy)
   170→
   171→    # --- Cleanup: prune resolved subjective IDs --------------------------
   172→    # Keep unscored IDs always. Keep stale/under-target only when objective
   173→    # backlog is clear, or when intentionally front-loading right after a
   174→    # completed cycle.
   175→    keep_ids = unscored_ids | injectable_ids
   176→    if objective_backlog and not cycle_just_completed:
   177→        keep_ids = unscored_ids
   178→    _prune_subjective_ids(order, keep_ids=keep_ids, pruned=result.pruned)
   179→
   180→    # --- Inject stale + under-target dimensions --------------------------
   181→    should_inject = not objective_backlog or cycle_just_completed
   182→
   183→    if should_inject and injectable_ids:
   184→        _inject_subjective_ids(order, inject_ids=injectable_ids, injected=result.injected)
   185→
   186→    return result
   187→
   188→
   189→__all__ = [
   190→    "current_under_target_ids",
   191→    "current_unscored_ids",
   192→    "sync_stale_dimensions",
   193→    "sync_unscored_dimensions",
   194→]
   195→
```

```
1→"""Shared helpers for queue-sync decisions.
     2→
     3→Every sync module (``sync_triage``, ``sync_dimensions``, ``sync_workflow``,
     4→``auto_cluster_sync``) needs to answer two questions:
     5→
     6→1. **Is there an objective backlog?**  (Should we defer optional items?)
     7→2. **Are we mid-cycle?**  (Has a queue cycle started and not yet completed?)
     8→
     9→This module provides a single definition of each so the logic stays
    10→consistent and changes propagate everywhere at once.
    11→"""
    12→
    13→from __future__ import annotations
    14→
    15→from desloppify.engine._plan.schema import PlanModel
    16→from desloppify.engine._plan.subjective_policy import (
    17→    NON_OBJECTIVE_DETECTORS as _NON_OBJECTIVE_DETECTORS,
    18→)
    19→from desloppify.engine._plan.subjective_policy import (
    20→    SubjectiveVisibility,
    21→)
    22→from desloppify.engine._state.schema import StateModel
    23→
    24→
    25→def has_objective_backlog(
    26→    state_or_issues: StateModel | dict,
    27→    policy: SubjectiveVisibility | None,
    28→) -> bool:
    29→    """Return whether an objective backlog exists (open non-subjective issues).
    30→
    31→    Prefers the pre-computed *policy* snapshot when available.
    32→    Falls back to scanning *state_or_issues* directly — accepts either a
    33→    full ``StateModel`` (looks up ``issues``) or a raw issues dict.
    34→    """
    35→    if policy is not None:
    36→        return policy.has_objective_backlog
    37→
    38→    # Accept either full state payload (`{"issues": ...}`) or raw issues dict.
    39→    issues = state_or_issues
    40→    if isinstance(state_or_issues, dict):
    41→        maybe_issues = state_or_issues.get("issues")
    42→        if isinstance(maybe_issues, dict):
    43→            issues = maybe_issues
    44→    return any(
    45→        f.get("status") == "open"
    46→        and f.get("detector") not in _NON_OBJECTIVE_DETECTORS
    47→        and not f.get("suppressed")
    48→        for f in issues.values()
    49→    )
    50→
    51→
    52→def is_mid_cycle(plan: PlanModel) -> bool:
    53→    """True when a queue cycle is in progress.
    54→
    55→    A cycle is active when ``plan_start_scores`` is set to real score
    56→    values.  The ``{"reset": True}`` sentinel (set by lifecycle reset)
    57→    does NOT count as mid-cycle — it means "seed real scores on next scan".
    58→    """
    59→    scores = plan.get("plan_start_scores")
    60→    return bool(scores) and not (isinstance(scores, dict) and scores.get("reset"))
    61→
    62→
    63→__all__ = ["has_objective_backlog", "is_mid_cycle"]
    64→
```

> AGENT

Found it. Here's the problem:

**All 20 subjective dimensions are permanently wontfixed** in the plan's `skipped` dict, but they're all still **unscored placeholders** in the state. The system correctly identifies them as needing review (`sync_unscored_dimensions` computes 20 unscored IDs), but:

1. `_inject_subjective_ids` adds them to `queue_order` — but doesn't touch the `skipped` dict
2. `separate_skipped` in the queue builder strips them out because they're in `skipped`
3. User sees an empty queue — no prompt to review, rescan, or retriage

Compare with `_inject` in `sync_workflow.py` which **does** clear skipped entries:

```python
def _inject(plan, item_id):
    order = plan["queue_order"]
    order.append(item_id)
    skipped = plan.get("skipped", {})
    if isinstance(skipped, dict):
        skipped.pop(item_id, None)  # ← clears the skip!
```

But `_inject_subjective_ids` never does this. So permanently-skipped subjective dimensions are invisible forever, even when the system knows they need attention.

The fix: when the sync determines a subjective dimension is unscored or stale, it should clear any skip entry — the system's determination that review is needed overrides a previous skip.

```
   128→def sync_unscored_dimensions(

   131→) -> QueueSyncResult:
   132→    """Keep the plan queue in sync with unscored (placeholder) subjective dimensions.

   175→def sync_stale_dimensions(

   188→       stale/under-target IDs are also evicted so they do not block objective work.
```

> AGENT

4817 passed, 0 failures.

Good question. Let me trace through the timing. The resurfacing happens in `sync_unscored_dimensions`, which has this guard at line 144:

```python
if is_mid_cycle(plan):
    return result
```

So **mid-cycle** (when `plan_start_scores` has real scores), unscored dimensions are NOT injected or resurfaced — they wait until the cycle ends. That's correct behavior: don't interrupt objective work with subjective reviews.

But in the Reigh case, `plan_start_scores` is `{}` (no active cycle), so `is_mid_cycle` returns False, meaning it WOULD resurface them on the next scan. That's also correct — there's no active cycle, so surfacing unscored work is appropriate.

The one edge case: what if the user starts a new cycle (seeds plan_start_scores) and THEN the 7 remaining objective items get resolved? Let me trace:

1. Scan runs → `_seed_plan_start_scores` sets real scores → `is_mid_cycle` = True
2. `sync_unscored_dimensions` returns early (mid-cycle guard)
3. User resolves objective items, queue drains
4. Next scan → `_clear_plan_start_scores_if_queue_empty` clears scores → `is_mid_cycle` = False
5. `sync_unscored_dimensions` now runs → resurfaces the skipped unscored dimensions

So yes — it only resurfaces at the appropriate time. Mid-cycle, the guard blocks it. After the cycle ends (or when no cycle is active, like Reigh's current state), it resurfaces.

```
## Audit of Uncommitted Changes

### Summary: 15 files changed, -820/+624 lines (net -196). Mostly good changes.

### 1. `desloppify/engine/_plan/sync_dimensions.py` -- **Good**

Core bug fix. Permanently-skipped unscored subjective dimensions were never being resurfaced for initial review. The fix:
- Adds `_skipped_subjective_ids()` helper to find skipped subjective IDs.
- Adds `_prune_skipped_subjective_ids()` to repair queue/skipped overlap invariants.
- In `sync_unscored_dimensions()`: clears skip entries for unscored IDs (they've never been scored, so a permanent skip is premature) and records them in `result.resurfaced`.
- In `sync_stale_dimensions()`: filters skipped IDs out of `injectable_ids` and repairs overlap.

Logic is clean and well-commented. Correctly handles the edge case where an unscored dimension was prematurely skipped.

### 2. `desloppify/engine/_plan/constants.py` -- **Good**

Adds `resurfaced: list[str]` field to `QueueSyncResult` dataclass, and includes it in the `changes` property. Direct support for the sync_dimensions fix above.

### 3. `desloppify/app/commands/scan/plan_reconcile.py` -- **Good**

- Prints a message when resurfaced dimensions are detected (user-facing feedback for the new behavior).
- Tightens `runtime` parameter type from `Any` to `ScanRuntime` (using `TYPE_CHECKING` import). Minor but correct improvement.
- Removes `runtime.state["_plan_reconcile_save_failed"] = True` -- no remaining references confirm this was dead code.

### 4. `desloppify/engine/_plan/auto_cluster_sync.py` -- **Good**

Prevents skipped subjective IDs from being re-queued by auto-clustering. Adds `_skipped_subjective_ids()` (duplicated from sync_dimensions.py -- see note below), filters them from `under_target_ids`, and removes overlapping entries from `queue_order`.

**Minor concern**: `_skipped_subjective_ids()` is defined identically in both `sync_dimensions.py` and `auto_cluster_sync.py`. Could be extracted to a shared helper. Not a blocking issue -- the function is small (8 lines) and both modules operate independently.

### 5. `desloppify/app/commands/plan/_resolve.py` -- **Good**

Adds glob/prefix matching against plan IDs (skipped, queued, clustered) before falling back to queue ID matching. Six clean lines. Fills a gap where patterns like `subjective::*` wouldn't match plan-level IDs.

### 6. `desloppify/app/commands/plan/override_skip.py` -- **Good with reservations**

Two additions:

**Deferral attestation (lines 108-145)**: When `--confirm` is used with a temporary skip, requires `--reason` and an `--attest` string containing specific phrases ("i have actually reflected", "not deferring"). This is an intentional friction mechanism to prevent lazy deferral.

- Assessment: The concept is sound (preventing thoughtless deferrals), but requiring exact magic phrases feels **slightly over-engineered**. A simpler `--attest` flag (boolean) + mandatory `--reason` would achieve 90% of the same effect with less user friction. That said, this is a deliberate design choice for a tool that coaches behavior, so it's defensible.

**Wontfix hint (lines 213-220)**: After a temporary skip succeeds, prints a suggestion to use `--permanent` if the user doesn't actually plan to fix the items. Helpful nudge -- **good**.

### 7. `desloppify/app/commands/plan/triage/stage_flow_enrich_sense.py` (deleted) -- **Good**

This was a pure re-export shim. Per the project's backward compatibility policy, re-export facades should be removed. The imports in `stage_flow_commands.py` are updated to point directly at `stage_flow_enrich` and `stage_flow_sense_check`.

### 8. `desloppify/app/commands/plan/triage/stage_flow_commands.py` -- **Good (Neutral)**

### 9. `desloppify/app/commands/review/_runner_parallel_loop.py` (deleted) + `runner_parallel.py` -- **Good**

348-line file deleted. No remaining importers. The file contained serial/parallel execution loop helpers. Grep confirms zero references remain.

`runner_parallel.py` also simplifies a pointless `write_back_failed` flag pattern -- the old code set a boolean, checked it, logged a debug message, then continued anyway. Now it just catches the exception and warns. Cleaner.

### 10. `desloppify/app/commands/review/batch/core_normalize.py` + `core_normalize_logic.py` (deleted) -- **Good (Neutral)**

Inlines `core_normalize_logic.py` (414 lines) directly into `core_normalize.py`, which was previously just a re-export shim. The code is identical -- this is a pure structural collapse removing one level of indirection. Follows the backward compat policy.

### 11. Test files -- **Good**

- `test_triage_stage_prompts_flow_direct.py`: Updates imports to match the shim removal. Mechanical.
- `test_auto_cluster_sync_direct.py`: Adds a test verifying skipped under-target IDs don't get re-queued. Good coverage for the auto_cluster_sync fix.
- `test_stale_dimensions.py`: Adds two tests -- one for resurfacing skipped unscored IDs, one for repairing skipped/queue overlap. Good coverage for the sync_dimensions fix.
```

```
    fix: lifecycle filter recognizes clusters as objective work and backfill triaged_ids after partial triage
    
    Two bugs that caused false triage forcing mid-cycle:
    
    1. _has_objective_items() only checked kind=="issue", missing
       kind=="cluster". When all objective issues were collapsed into
       clusters, triage was forced even with real work remaining.
    
    2. After partial triage (some stages confirmed, rest skipped),
       triaged_ids was never populated. This caused sync_triage_needed()
       to see all review issues as "new" on every run, creating an
       infinite re-triage loop on cycle boundaries.
```

```
   529→   529→+def _validate_dimension_note(
   530→   530→+    key: str,
   531→   531→+    note_raw: object,
   532→   532→+) -> tuple[list[object], str, str, str, str]:
   533→   533→+    """Validate a single dimension_notes entry and return parsed fields.
   534→   534→+
   535→   535→+    Returns (evidence, impact_scope, fix_scope, confidence, issues_preventing_higher_score).
   536→   536→+    Raises ValueError on invalid structure.
   537→   537→+    """
   538→   538→+    if not isinstance(note_raw, dict):
   539→   539→+        raise ValueError(
   540→   540→+            f"dimension_notes missing object for assessed dimension: {key}"
   541→   541→+        )
   542→   542→+    evidence = note_raw.get("evidence")
   543→   543→+    impact_scope = note_raw.get("impact_scope")
   544→   544→+    fix_scope = note_raw.get("fix_scope")
   545→   545→+    if not isinstance(evidence, list) or not evidence:
   546→   546→+        raise ValueError(
   547→   547→+            f"dimension_notes.{key}.evidence must be a non-empty array"
   548→   548→+        )
   549→   549→+    if not isinstance(impact_scope, str) or not impact_scope.strip():
   550→   550→+        raise ValueError(
   551→   551→+            f"dimension_notes.{key}.impact_scope must be a non-empty string"
   552→   552→+        )
   553→   553→+    if not isinstance(fix_scope, str) or not fix_scope.strip():
   554→   554→+        raise ValueError(
   555→   555→+            f"dimension_notes.{key}.fix_scope must be a non-empty string"
   556→   556→+        )
   557→   557→+
   558→   558→+    confidence_raw = str(note_raw.get("confidence", "medium")).strip().lower()
   559→   559→+    confidence = (
   560→   560→+        confidence_raw if confidence_raw in {"high", "medium", "low"} else "medium"
   561→   561→+    )
   562→   562→+    issues_note = str(note_raw.get(DIMENSION_NOTE_ISSUES_KEY, "")).strip()
   563→   563→+    if not issues_note:
   564→   564→+        issues_note = str(note_raw.get(LEGACY_DIMENSION_NOTE_ISSUES_KEY, "")).strip()
   565→   565→+    return evidence, impact_scope, fix_scope, confidence, issues_note

   568→   568→+def _normalize_abstraction_sub_axes(
   569→   569→+    note_raw: dict[str, object],
   570→   570→+    abstraction_sub_axes: tuple[str, ...],
   571→   571→+) -> dict[str, float]:
   572→   572→+    """Extract and clamp abstraction_fitness sub-axis scores from a note."""
   573→   573→+    sub_axes_raw = note_raw.get("sub_axes")
   574→   574→+    if sub_axes_raw is not None and not isinstance(sub_axes_raw, dict):
   575→   575→+        raise ValueError(
   576→   576→+            "dimension_notes.abstraction_fitness.sub_axes must be an object"
   577→   577→+        )
   578→   578→+    if not isinstance(sub_axes_raw, dict):
   579→   579→+        return {}
   580→   580→+
   581→   581→+    normalized: dict[str, float] = {}
   582→   582→+    for axis in abstraction_sub_axes:
   583→   583→+        axis_value = sub_axes_raw.get(axis)
   584→   584→+        if axis_value is None:
   585→   585→+            continue
   586→   586→+        if isinstance(axis_value, bool) or not isinstance(axis_value, int | float):
   587→   587→+            raise ValueError(
   588→   588→+                f"dimension_notes.abstraction_fitness.sub_axes.{axis} "
   589→   589→+                "must be numeric"
   590→   590→+            )
   591→   591→+        normalized[axis] = round(
   592→   592→+            max(0.0, min(100.0, float(axis_value))),
   593→   593→+            1,
   594→   594→+        )
   595→   595→+    return normalized

   598→   598→+def _validate_dimension_judgment(
   599→   599→+    key: str,
   600→   600→+    raw: object,
   601→   601→+    *,
   602→   602→+    log_fn,
   603→   603→+) -> BatchDimensionJudgmentPayload | None:
   604→   604→+    """Validate a single dimension_judgment entry. Returns cleaned payload or None."""
   605→   605→+    if not isinstance(raw, dict):
   606→   606→+        log_fn(f"  dimension_judgment.{key}: expected object, skipping")
   607→   607→+        return None
   608→   608→+
   609→   609→+    strengths_raw = raw.get("strengths")
   610→   610→+    if not isinstance(strengths_raw, list):
   611→   611→+        strengths: list[str] = []
   612→   612→+    else:
   613→   613→+        strengths = [
   614→   614→+            str(s).strip()
   615→   615→+            for s in strengths_raw[:5]
   616→   616→+            if isinstance(s, str) and str(s).strip()
   617→   617→+        ]
   618→   618→+
   619→   619→+    issue_character = ""
   620→   620→+    ic_raw = raw.get("issue_character")
   621→   621→+    if isinstance(ic_raw, str) and ic_raw.strip():
   622→   622→+        issue_character = ic_raw.strip()
   623→   623→+    else:
   624→   624→+        log_fn(f"  dimension_judgment.{key}.issue_character: missing or empty")
   625→   625→+
   626→   626→+    score_rationale = ""
   627→   627→+    sr_raw = raw.get("score_rationale")
   628→   628→+    if isinstance(sr_raw, str) and sr_raw.strip():
   629→   629→+        score_rationale = sr_raw.strip()
   630→   630→+        if len(score_rationale) < 50:
   631→   631→+            log_fn(
   632→   632→+                f"  dimension_judgment.{key}.score_rationale: "
   633→   633→+                f"too short ({len(score_rationale)} chars, want ≥50)"
   634→   634→+            )
   635→   635→+    else:
   636→   636→+        log_fn(f"  dimension_judgment.{key}.score_rationale: missing or empty")
   637→   637→+
   638→   638→+    if not issue_character and not score_rationale and not strengths:
   639→   639→+        return None
   640→   640→+
   641→   641→+    result: BatchDimensionJudgmentPayload = {}
   642→   642→+    if strengths:
   643→   643→+        result["strengths"] = strengths
   644→   644→+    if issue_character:
   645→   645→+        result["issue_character"] = issue_character
   646→   646→+    if score_rationale:
   647→   647→+        result["score_rationale"] = score_rationale
   648→   648→+    return result

   651→   651→+def _normalize_issues(
   652→   652→+    raw_issues: object,
   653→   653→+    dimension_notes: dict[str, BatchDimensionNotePayload],
   654→   654→+    *,
   655→   655→+    max_batch_issues: int,
   656→   656→+    allowed_dims: set[str],
   657→   657→+    low_score_dimensions: set[str] | None = None,
   658→   658→+) -> list[NormalizedBatchIssue]:
   659→   659→+    """Validate and normalize the issues array from a batch payload."""
   660→   660→+    if not isinstance(raw_issues, list):
   661→   661→+        raise ValueError("issues must be an array")
   662→   662→+
   663→   663→+    issues: list[NormalizedBatchIssue] = []
   664→   664→+    errors: list[str] = []
   665→   665→+    for idx, item in enumerate(raw_issues):
   666→   666→+        issue: ReviewIssuePayload | None
   667→   667→+        issue, issue_errors = validate_review_issue_payload(
   668→   668→+            item,
   669→   669→+            label=f"issues[{idx}]",
   670→   670→+            allowed_dimensions=allowed_dims,
   671→   671→+            allow_dismissed=False,
   672→   672→+        )
   673→   673→+        if issue_errors:
   674→   674→+            errors.extend(issue_errors)
   675→   675→+            continue
   676→   676→+        if issue is None:
   677→   677→+            raise ValueError(
   678→   678→+                "batch issue payload missing after validation succeeded"
   679→   679→+            )
   680→   680→+
   681→   681→+        dim = issue["dimension"]
   682→   682→+        note = dimension_notes.get(dim, {})
   683→   683→+        impact_scope = str(
   684→   684→+            (item if isinstance(item, dict) else {}).get(
   685→   685→+                "impact_scope", note.get("impact_scope", "")
   686→   686→+            )
   687→   687→+        ).strip()
   688→   688→+        fix_scope = str(
   689→   689→+            (item if isinstance(item, dict) else {}).get(
   690→   690→+                "fix_scope", note.get("fix_scope", "")
   691→   691→+            )
   692→   692→+        ).strip()
   693→   693→+        if not impact_scope or not fix_scope:
   694→   694→+            errors.append(
   695→   695→+                f"issues[{idx}] requires impact_scope and fix_scope "
   696→   696→+                "(or dimension_notes defaults)"
   697→   697→+            )
   698→   698→+            continue
   699→   699→+        issues.append(
   700→   700→+            NormalizedBatchIssue(
   701→   701→+                dimension=issue["dimension"],
   702→   702→+                identifier=issue["identifier"],
   703→   703→+                summary=issue["summary"],
   704→   704→+                confidence=issue["confidence"],
   705→   705→+                suggestion=issue["suggestion"],
   706→   706→+                related_files=list(issue.get("related_files", [])),
   707→   707→+                evidence=list(issue.get("evidence", [])),
   708→   708→+                impact_scope=impact_scope,
   709→   709→+                fix_scope=fix_scope,
   710→   710→+                reasoning=str(issue.get("reasoning", "")),
   711→   711→+                evidence_lines=list(issue.get("evidence_lines", []))
   712→   712→+                if isinstance(issue.get("evidence_lines"), list)
   713→   713→+                else None,
   714→   714→+            )
   715→   715→+        )
   716→   716→+    if errors:
   717→   717→+        visible = errors[:10]
   718→   718→+        remaining = len(errors) - len(visible)
   719→   719→+        if remaining > 0:
   720→   720→+            visible.append(f"... {remaining} additional issue schema error(s) omitted")
   721→   721→+        raise ValueError("; ".join(visible))
   722→   722→+    if len(issues) <= max_batch_issues:
   723→   723→+        return issues
   724→   724→+
   725→   725→+    required_dims = set(low_score_dimensions or set())
   726→   726→+    if not required_dims:

   728→   728→+
   729→   729→+    # Preserve at least one issue per low-score dimension before trimming.
   730→   730→+    selected: list[NormalizedBatchIssue] = []
   731→   731→+    selected_indexes: set[int] = set()
   732→   732→+    covered: set[str] = set()
   733→   733→+    for idx, issue in enumerate(issues):
   734→   734→+        if len(selected) >= max_batch_issues:
   735→   735→+            break
   736→   736→+        dim = issue.dimension.strip()
   737→   737→+        if dim not in required_dims or dim in covered:
   738→   738→+            continue
   739→   739→+        selected.append(issue)
   740→   740→+        selected_indexes.add(idx)
   741→   741→+        covered.add(dim)
   742→   742→+
   743→   743→+    for idx, issue in enumerate(issues):
   744→   744→+        if len(selected) >= max_batch_issues:
   745→   745→+            break
   746→   746→+        if idx in selected_indexes:
   747→   747→+            continue
   748→   748→+        selected.append(issue)
   749→   749→+    return selected
```
